name: Uszód (Hungary)
description: Blue field with a yellow diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a green triangle in the lower fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Uszód: a blue shield with a row of green poplars on a yellow base, above a blue scroll inscribed USZÓD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
